name: Frustum Culling for Octree Nodes
definition: A hierarchical culling technique that discards entire octree subtrees if their bounding box (AABB) is outside the view frustum, avoiding per-point processing for millions of points with a single box test.
summary: Frustum culling for octree nodes is a hierarchical visibility test that discards entire subtrees if their axis-aligned bounding box lies outside the view frustum, focusing purely on geometric containment without occlusion.
